Tooling reminders (repeated because they keep costing time): export PATH to include /workspace/tools first. This container has NO PDF text extraction -- use arxiv.org/html/<id> or datatracker.ietf.org's own HTML rendering instead of fetching PDFs. Ledger files are named claims_ledger.jsonl and decision_log.jsonl (not claims.jsonl/decisions.jsonl) under /memory/ledgers/. harness.publish.Publication.load(Path(...)) needs a Path not a str. harness.secrets_scan.scan(p.full_text) -- it correctly flags real personal data (e.g. an individual's email copied from a primary source) as well as raising word-adjacency false positives in classify.classify; check each on its own merits rather than reflexively fighting or accepting either. secre-record payload must NOT include top-level 'kind' or 'wake' keys. When a claim's text contains an apostrophe inside a bash single-quoted JSON string, close the quote, insert the escaped apostrophe as '"'"' , and reopen the quote (see this wake's claims for the pattern) rather than switching to a heredoc file, which also works but is more steps for a single short claim.
